cctv.title: CCTV
cctv.desc: Monitor your business site around the clock from your phone, whether you are on site or away. Nakha Solution helps you select the cameras, plan each installation point, set up recording storage, and connect the system for straightforward access.
cctv.summary: Monitor your site around the clock, keep the recordings, and access every camera from your phone.
features: Monitor key points across your business site around the clock.
Keep high-resolution recordings to support incident review.
Check day-to-day operations from your phone while you are away.
Match the camera combination and viewing coverage to your site.

detail.benefitTitle: What will your CCTV system cover?
detail.benefitIntro: The system is planned around the areas you need to watch, the recording quality you need, and the way your team will access the footage.
detail.typesTitle: Choose the camera form for each installation area
detail.typesIntro: We recommend the camera type after reviewing the viewing angle, monitoring distance, and site conditions.
detail.faqIntro: Short answers to the questions clients usually ask before a consultation.

faq.question: Where can I get the full CCTV pricing details?
faq.answer: Full pricing is available through a WhatsApp consultation. Our team will match it to the number of points, camera types, and site conditions.

faq.question: Can I choose CCTV equipment outside the listed packages?
faq.answer: Yes. The brand, quantity, and camera types can be adjusted to suit your business needs.

faq.question: What is the minimum number of cameras for an installation?
faq.answer: Installation starts from two cameras connected within one system.

faq.question: How do I start a CCTV installation?
faq.answer: Select Consult about CCTV below. The Nakha Solution team will contact you to discuss the site, camera count, and monitoring needs.

digital-marketing.title: Digital Marketing Tools
digital-marketing.desc: Manage social media publishing, promotional broadcasts, giveaways, and campaign results in one workflow. Your marketing team can schedule the work, distribute the material, and see which channels generate a response.
digital-marketing.summary: Schedule content, distribute promotions, and review campaign results in one workflow.
features: Schedule content so the marketing calendar stays organized.
Distribute promotions through WhatsApp and email to the intended lists.
Review clicks, open rates, and conversions for each campaign.
Connect the creative team's work with marketing manager approvals.

detail.benefitTitle: One workflow for day-to-day marketing work
detail.benefitIntro: Choose the tools around the work you need to organize, from content planning to campaign reporting.
detail.typesTitle: Use the tools that match your team's workflow
detail.typesIntro: Each module can handle a specific need or connect with the others as one marketing process.
detail.faqIntro: Confirm the channels, integrations, and campaign workflow before selecting a setup.

faq.question: Does WhatsApp broadcast follow platform policies?
faq.answer: Messages use official routes and remain subject to messaging policies, recipient consent, and the current platform requirements.

faq.question: Can we track where a lead came from?
faq.answer: Yes. UTM tracking can show which campaign and channel brought a visit or lead.

faq.question: Can a nontechnical marketing team use the tools?
faq.answer: The interface is arranged around everyday tasks such as scheduling content, reviewing responses, and reading reports.

faq.question: Which platforms can be used with the comment picker?
faq.answer: Comment picker campaigns can be prepared for Instagram or TikTok, including comment and participant filtering based on the campaign rules.

detail.ctaTitle: Which marketing task should be organized first?

device-bundling.title: Device Bundling
device-bundling.desc: Procure workplace devices and IT infrastructure in one package shaped around your operations. The devices are selected, checked for compatibility, and configured so they are ready to use when they reach your office.
device-bundling.summary: Office devices selected, matched, and configured through one procurement process.
features: Make sure the devices in each package work together without compatibility issues.
Prepare the initial configuration so the devices can be used right away.
Combine several device categories in one procurement process.
Support warranty handling and after-sales requirements.

detail.benefitIntro: Each package is based on its users, required applications, network conditions, and procurement budget.
detail.typesTitle: Complete the office setup through one procurement
detail.typesIntro: Brands, specifications, and quantities are set after the requirements of each team are mapped.
detail.faqIntro: Short answers about device coverage, pricing, and added value within a package.

faq.question: Which office devices can be supplied?
faq.answer: Information and communications technology hardware can be assembled as one solution around your operational needs.

faq.question: What is the benefit of buying through Nakha Solution?
faq.answer: You can handle several device categories through one process, including selection, compatibility checks, and initial configuration.

faq.question: What does added value mean in this service?
faq.answer: Added value is agreed during consultation. It can include a connectivity package, monitoring dashboard, or a simple information system that supports the selected devices.

faq.question: Why is there no fixed price list?
faq.answer: Pricing depends on the brands, specifications, quantities, and required configuration. The cost breakdown is prepared after the procurement needs are confirmed.

campaign-activation.title: Campaign Activation Platform
campaign-activation.desc: Run giveaways, score predictions, and audience activations without checking participants one by one. Campaign rules are applied to participant data, draws can be shown live, and the results are summarized for your team.
campaign-activation.summary: Manage participants, apply the rules, run the draw, and summarize campaign results.
features: Filter participants by keywords, tags, or campaign rules.
Run a draw that can be shown while the activation is live.
Collect predictions and participant details through campaign forms.
Keep the winners and result summary for review.

detail.benefitTitle: Set the campaign rules from the start
detail.benefitIntro: The team defines the mechanism, participant requirements, and results to record before the activation opens.
detail.typesTitle: Choose an interaction format for the audience
detail.typesIntro: Each format can be used on its own or combined with others to match the campaign mechanism.
detail.faqIntro: Confirm the data source, filtering rules, and result presentation before launch.

faq.question: Which participant rules can be applied?
faq.answer: Filtering can use comment keywords, the number of friend tags, or other participant data agreed in the campaign mechanism.

faq.question: Can the draw be shown live?
faq.answer: Yes. The live draw flow can be prepared so the winner selection is shown while the activation is running.

faq.question: Can a score prediction campaign calculate points?
faq.answer: Yes. Points can be based on the exact score or match result, then displayed in a leaderboard.

faq.question: What do we receive after the campaign ends?
faq.answer: Your team receives the winner data and result summary based on the information collected during the campaign.

web-development.title: Web Development
web-development.desc: Build a website that serves as an official reference for prospective customers, partners, or service users. Its pages, content, and features are organized around the business goal and the way your team will manage it after launch.
web-development.summary: A professional website shaped around the business goal, content, and team workflow.
features: Present the company profile, services, and contact details in one official place.
Adapt the layout for desktop, tablet, and phone screens.
Structure pages so people and search engines can understand the content.
Give the team access to update articles or products through a CMS.

detail.benefitTitle: A website to use, not just display
detail.benefitIntro: The goal, audience, content material, and management workflow are discussed before design and development begin.
detail.typesTitle: Choose the website format by the work it needs to do
detail.typesIntro: Feature scope and delivery time depend on the website type and the readiness of your team's materials.
detail.faqIntro: The main factors affecting the schedule, cost, and website management after launch.

faq.question: How long does website development take?
faq.answer: Development usually takes 1 to 12 weeks, depending on feature complexity and the readiness of the content materials.

faq.question: Does the cost include a domain and hosting?
faq.answer: The domain and hosting are included for the first year. Renewal costs will be shared based on the website requirements.

faq.question: What happens if the website has a problem?
faq.answer: Issues or bugs caused by our technical work are covered by a six-month warranty after the website goes live.

faq.question: Can our team update the content?
faq.answer: Yes. A CMS can be prepared so your team can update articles, pages, or products without changing the code.

detail.ctaTitle: What kind of website needs to go live?

business-application.title: Business Application
business-application.desc: Connect data and work across the company through applications that follow your operational flow. The system can begin with one need, such as point of sale or inventory, then expand into other modules as the business grows.
business-application.summary: Applications that connect transactions, inventory, people, finance, and operational work.
features: Reduce repeated data entry across company departments.
Automate routine work that was previously handled by hand.
Provide operational reports to support management decisions.
Add modules gradually as the business requirements grow.

detail.benefitTitle: Start with the process that needs attention first
detail.benefitIntro: We map the workflow first so the application follows how the team works instead of forcing the team into the wrong system.
detail.typesTitle: Combine modules around the company's operations
detail.typesIntro: Each module can operate on its own or connect through data integrations.
detail.faqIntro: Module scope, data readiness, and integration requirements determine the shape of the project.

faq.question: Are business applications only for large companies?
faq.answer: No. Implementation can start with the basic module you need most, then expand as the business process grows.

faq.question: How long does implementation take?
faq.answer: Implementation time varies. An ERP project can take one to six months, depending on process complexity and data readiness.

faq.question: Will our team receive training?
faq.answer: Yes. Implementation includes training and user acceptance testing so the team understands the system workflow.

faq.question: Can the system connect with our other applications?
faq.answer: Yes. Integration with POS, HRIS, e-commerce, or IoT devices is planned around the systems your company already uses.

Portfolio.title: Projects we have already built.
Portfolio.description: Four website projects for two law firms, a contractor, and an Umrah travel service.

raya.title: Raya Law Firm
raya.desc: A law firm website that brings practice areas, lawyer profiles, and the consultation path into one place.
raya.challengeText: Raya Law Firm needed a strong online presence to establish credibility and attract new clients. Their previous digital footprint was non-existent, making it difficult for potential clients to find information about their legal services and attorney expertise.
raya.solutionText: We designed and developed a modern, fast, and SEO-optimized website using Next.js. The site features a clean, professional aesthetic appropriate for a law firm, with clear sections for practice areas, attorney profiles, and an easy-to-use consultation request form.
raya.impactText: The active site now places practice areas, lawyer profiles, and the consultation path in one place. Any further business impact should be assessed from the client's own data.

putra.title: Putra Wijaya Mandiri
putra.desc: A corporate portfolio that organizes construction projects and industrial services for B2B prospects.
putra.challengeText: As a growing general contractor, Putra Wijaya Mandiri struggled to showcase their extensive portfolio of industrial and construction projects to potential large-scale clients. They needed a corporate platform that communicated reliability, scale, and professionalism.
putra.solutionText: We built a robust corporate website focusing on visual storytelling. We implemented a dynamic project portfolio section that allows them to categorize and display high-quality images and details of their completed projects. The site is fully responsive and optimized for B2B client acquisition.
putra.impactText: The active portfolio can be used when introducing projects and industrial services to B2B prospects. Any further commercial impact should be assessed from the client's own data.

alfajr.title: Alfajr Umroh
alfajr.desc: An Umrah service website that brings packages, travel information, and customer inquiries into one place.
alfajr.challengeText: Alfajr Umroh faced challenges in managing customer inquiries and explaining complex Umrah packages manually. They needed a centralized digital platform where prospective pilgrims could easily browse packages, view itineraries, and understand the requirements.
alfajr.solutionText: We developed a comprehensive travel portal tailored for Umrah services. The website features detailed package listings, day-by-day itineraries, transparent pricing, and an integrated inquiry system. We focused on a user-friendly interface that builds trust and provides clear information.
alfajr.impactText: The active site now brings packages, travel information, and customer questions into one place. Any further conversion or operations impact should be assessed from the client's own data.

justitia.title: Justitia Law Firm
justitia.desc: A law firm website that organizes services, profiles, projects, news, articles, and the consultation path in a responsive interface.
justitia.challengeText: The firm's information needed to remain clear and accessible on desktop, laptop, and smartphone screens, including navigation, service summaries, and the consultation path.
justitia.solutionText: We structured the page with clear hierarchy, navigation that adapts to screen width, a prominent profile presentation, service summaries, and consultation actions that remain visible at each size.
justitia.impactText: The result is a responsive interface with consistent structure across three screen sizes. Any further commercial impact should be assessed from the client's own data.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Nakha Solution ("we") values the privacy of our visitors and clients. This policy explains what data we collect through this website, how it is used, and how you can contact us about your data.

sections.title: 1. Data We Collect
sections.body: We may collect your name, email address, WhatsApp number, and message content that you voluntarily submit through our contact form or WhatsApp links on this website. We may also collect non-personal technical data such as device type and pages visited through third-party analytics tools.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Data
sections.body: The data you provide is used to respond to your inquiries, follow up on consultation requests via WhatsApp or email, and improve our services. We do not sell or rent your personal data to any third party.

sections.title: 3. Meta Pixel, Google Analytics & Cookies
sections.body: This website uses Meta Pixel (Facebook/Instagram) and Google Analytics to measure the effectiveness of our advertising campaigns and understand how visitors interact with our site. These tools may store cookies on your device and send interaction data (such as page visits or WhatsApp button clicks) to Meta Platforms, Inc. and Google LLC in accordance with their respective privacy policies. You may disable cookies through your browser settings.

sections.title: 4. Sharing Data with Third Parties
sections.body: When you contact us via WhatsApp, that conversation is processed through the WhatsApp/Meta platform in accordance with their privacy policy. We do not share your personal data with other third parties for marketing purposes without your consent.

sections.title: 5. Data Security
sections.body: We take reasonable measures to protect the data you provide from unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure. However, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure.

sections.title: 6. Your Rights
sections.body: You have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data held by us, in accordance with Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (UU PDP). To make such a request, please contact us via the email below.

sections.title: 7. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page along with the latest update date.

sections.title: 8. Contact Us
sections.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at nakhasolution@gmail.com.
